d:
Jharkhand vidhanasbha men MMDR Act ko lekar siyasi ghamasan dekhne ko mila. sadan men kangres ne bijepi par ganbhir aarop lagate hue MMDR kanun ko mukhyamantri hemant soren ke khilaph sajish bataya. aakhir kangres ne apne aaropon ke samarthan men kya dalil di aur vidhanasbha men is mudde par kya charcha huee? dekhie puri khabra.

Edited by: HARSH RAJ
